mechanism_narrative: Synchronized drops in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES indicate commuting and office activity are contracting, which removes weekday retail footfall; RETAIL_REC will continue falling over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days while TRANSIT remains below -40 and WORKPLACES below -25.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL crosses above +15 and TRANSIT falls below -45, stay-at-home orders are binding; non-essential retail remains closed and RETAIL_REC drops further over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose to 21.0 while TRANSIT fell to -55.4
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC 28-day mean exceeds the prior 28-day mean despite RESIDENTIAL staying above +15 and TRANSIT below -45.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in PARKS and TRANSIT signals broad withdrawal from public spaces; when both are below their baselines, retail-and-recreation trips are crowded out, lowering RETAIL_REC next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC weekly mean rises while PARKS remains below 0 and TRANSIT below -40.

mechanism_narrative: If policy eases enough for TRANSIT to rise above -45 and RESIDENTIAL to fall below +15, commuters and shoppers return; RETAIL_REC will rebound over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:current TRANSIT -55.4 and RESIDENTIAL 21.0 are beyond easing thresholds
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC 28-day mean does not exceed the prior 28-day mean after TRANSIT has risen above -45 and RESIDENTIAL has fallen below +15.

mechanism_narrative: A seasonal shift away from outdoor leisure reduces PARKS visits, and the lost outdoor-recreation demand drags RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks even without new restrictions.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from 27.3 to -15.6 across four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days while PARKS remains below its four-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: As RESIDENTIAL rises above +15 and GROCERY_PHARM turns negative, households restrict outings to essential errands; discretionary retail trips are crowded out, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC 28-day mean rises while RESIDENTIAL remains above +15 and GROCERY_PHARM remains below 0.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES below -35 and TRANSIT below -50 indicate a shutdown of commuting networks; the resulting loss of office-adjacent retail demand keeps RETAIL_REC depressed for four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over next 28 days is higher than last 28 days while WORKPLACES remains below -35 and TRANSIT below -50.

mechanism_narrative: A rising RESIDENTIAL share while WORKPLACES stays below -35 indicates policy stringency is still tightening; retail and recreation mobility will remain lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC 28-day mean exceeds prior 28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL remains above +18 and WORKPLACES below -35.
